[[Reforged Mode]] is an experimental [[optional game modes|optional game mode]] currently in Beta testing, added as part of [[Guild Wars Reforged]]. This game mode adds changes to the [[Guild Wars Prophecies|Prophecies]] [[campaign]], most notably additional content in [[Pre-Searing Ascalon]]. [[Character]]s from any campaign can opt out of Reforged Mode on the name selection screen of [[character creation]], and can freely toggle Reforged Mode after character creation at a [[Shrine to Godly Accoutrements]] in any of the major cities.

== Current Features ==
Reforged Mode offers a variety of content changes to the Prophecies campaign. The [[Reforged Mode (effect)|Reforged Mode]] effect and changes to [[zone]]s and [[NPC]]s are only applied when all players in a [[party]] are in Reforged Mode. Changes to rewards and skill costs are applied individually to each character in Reforged Mode, even in mixed parties.

=== General ===
* A small badge ([[File:ReforgedMode-Small.png|19px]]) is displayed next to character names of players that are in Reforged Mode.
* The [[skill trainer #Skill cost progression|skill cost progression curve]] is lowered by roughly half, capping out at {{cost|500}}.
** This change reduces the cost of the [[Skill Hunter]] title to roughly {{cost|145000}}.

=== Prophecies ===
* While you [[explorable area|explore areas]] in [[normal mode]], you will be under the effects of [[File:Reforged_Mode.jpg|25px|link=Reforged Mode (effect)]] [[Reforged Mode (effect)|Reforged Mode]], a permanent buff that grants a 5% bonus to gold dropped and experience gained from killing enemies.
* Access to the new dungeon [[Tunnels of the Forsaken]]
* New recruitable [[hero]]es [[Devona]] and [[Ghost of Althea]]
* Increased Prophecies [[mission]] rewards:
** The mission completion reward has been increased from 1,000 [[XP]] and 1{{skill point}} to 2,000 XP, 200 {{gold}}, and 1{{skill point}}.
** The bonus objective reward has been increased from 1,000 XP to 1,500 XP, 150 {{gold}}, and 1{{skill point}}.
** The [[hard mode]] mission completion reward has been increased from 2,000 XP, 500 {{gold}}, and 1{{skill point}} to 3,000 XP, 500 {{gold}}, and 1{{skill point}}.
* Several Prophecies quests have increased [[gold]] rewards.
** If a player toggles Reforged Mode on or off while one of these quests is in their quest log, the quest reward will update upon changing maps or districts, logging out, or claiming the reward.
* Revised [[henchmen]] skill bars.
** [[Alesia]] and [[Mhenlo]] use [[Resurrect]] instead of [[Restore Life]], and [[Reyna]] uses [[Savage Shot]] instead of [[Determined Shot]] at higher levels.
** Skill bar changes are applied upon leaving a [[town]] or [[outpost]], or entering a mission (except [[Ascalon Academy]]), and retained across multiple zones.
* Henchmen in early Prophecies areas have a higher level.
** Level 3 henchmen have their levels increased by 3, level 6-12 henchmen have their levels increased by 2, and level 15-17 henchmen have their levels increased by 1.
** The level increase is applied upon leaving a town or outpost, or entering a mission (except Ascalon Academy), and retained across multiple zones.
** Affected henchmen still use the builds associated with their level before the increase.

==== Pre-Searing Ascalon ====
* Access to the [[Getting Started in Guild Wars]] quest.
* Access to the [[A Bastion In the North]] quest chain in [[the Northlands]], which unlocks:
** the [[Piken Square (pre-Searing)|Piken Square]] outpost
** the [[Forsaken Tunnels]] dungeon
** [[Devona]] as a pre-searing [[hero]]
* Enemy health is reduced by 20% for all enemies, including hostile [[charmable animal]]s.
* Enemy armor is reduced by roughly 20% for most foes.
{{bug|Enemies with negative armor rating against certain [[damage type]]s will have their armor increased instead.}}
* Additional enemies appear in the Northlands:
** Groups of grawl including the stronger [[Grawl Crone]]s and [[Grawl Fighter]]s
** Groups of [[Oakheart]]s including the stronger [[Ironheart]]s
** Two groups of Charr at each of the two gates of the Great Wall. The gates are also closed now.

== Trivia ==
* Access to the alpha version of Reforged Mode was added as part of the [[Feedback:Game updates/20251218|December 18th, 2025]] update.
* Reforged Mode entered beta status on [[Feedback:Game updates/20260527|May 27, 2026]].
